text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementAstronomyWhy Elon Musk’s “Self-Growing” Moon Cities Are Tragically FlawedThere’s simply not enough waterJCBy Jake Currie5:00 PM CDT on September 15, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleHumanity has been seriously considering building a permanent presence on the moon for at least 70 years. Earlier this year, erratic billionaire Elon Musk went a bit further, promising a “self-growing” lunar city within just 10 years.
